newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ governor, vice governor due in parliament.
newsitem.headline: BOJ governor, vice governor due in parliament.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita and Vice-Governor Toshihiko Fukui are scheduled to appear before the financial committee of parliament's Lower House on Friday, the central bank said in a statement.
Matsushita is scheduled to appear between 9.35 a.m. (0035 GMT) and 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT) and Fukui between 11.05 a.m. (0205 GMT) and 12.05 p.m. (0305 GMT), it said.
